t: The Fortress Trade Angled Masonry Paint Brush, 4.75", is specifically engineered for professional outdoor painting tasks. This durable brush, with its angled head and synthetic bristles, is ideal for applying masonry paints to exterior walls, brickwork, and fences, easily reaching difficult spaces and corners. It offers high paint load capacity and excellent release, ensuring efficient coverage and a smooth finish with reduced tramlines thanks to its flagged tip. The ergonomic handle provides comfort during extended use, and the brush is quick and easy to clean, saving valuable time on site.
